That is extra information? "so that the training coordinators don't have to and links to slides." The phrase "and links to slides" appears out of place, not as rationale? This is extra detail likely requirement about links to slides. Does this contain means? It says "edit my training node myself" and then "and links to slides" maybe additional means. Minimal violation: contains extra information beyond role, means, ends? The core story mentions "links to slides" as a separate desire, not proper rationale; that is external to story sentence? Operational: comments, mock-up notes, implementation/testing hints, procedural notes, or other information external. "links to slides" seems additional requirement/means beyond simple means; could be violation. Need decide.
